reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Isotope-resolved pulse tracking, regeneration-step interruption/restoration and defined reconstitution with carbon balance.

checks.reason: No pre-execution consultation of prior primary Methods/supplements or validated tracer, inhibitor and reconstitution protocols with detailed-condition transfer checks.
Atom mapping and dose criteria are strong, but buffer/cofactor/temperature and quantitative preparation settings remain generic calibration requirements without an executable selection procedure.
Standards, spike recovery and closed-vessel controls are named, but no quantitative accuracy/recovery acceptance rule or objective derivation fixes what passes before confirmation.

Rejecting outlying endogenous pools as an alternative to stratification is not tied to an independent technical failure; biological pool variation must be retained/modelled rather than discarded for a convenient cycling test.
No refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after changing labels, sampling or perturbation in response to failures.
Material details and blinded identifiers lack linked raw files and exact model/code/environment/settings versions needed to reconstruct all contrasts.

Sound mapped-label, pool and net-flux reasoning with no historical overclaim. Source recorded and preparation integrity qualified; prospective sham/inactive/omission/restoration controls. Absolute moles-based turnover, enrichment/gas-partition/blank correction and unquantifiable-data stop are specified. Independent nested preparations with pilot power, randomized coding and paired interaction/equivalence uncertainty. Low-dose pilot bounded by detectability, toxicity and substrate/oxygen limits; time selection follows observed transit/quality. Diagnoses residual inhibitor versus damage and exchange; conditional decision requires joint isotope, restoration, balance and defined-enzyme omission/add-back with measured contamination limits.
